description: This file defines the UnsupportedMediaTypeException class, a custom runtime exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that an unsupported media type was used in a request. It includes builder methods for detailed error messages, JSON serialization/deserialization, and references relevant HTTP status codes and headers.

classes.name: UnsupportedMediaTypeException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an error when an unsupported media type is used in a request. It includes static factory methods for detailed error messaging and deserialization from JSON.

methods.name: withDetailedInformationBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder with detailed error message indicating the unsupported media type and supported media types.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.

inner_classes.name: Builder
inner_classes.description: A thread-unsafe mutable builder class to construct instances of UnsupportedMediaTypeException with customizable fields.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Internal method to create an UnsupportedMediaTypeException instance with specified parameters.
